## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests added or updated; they use no real hosts, ports or data.
- [ ] I ran the checks through `scripts/dev.sh` (`test`, `vet`, `fmt`), not host tools.
- [ ] Docs updated (README, ARCHITECTURE, developer guide) where behaviour changed.
- [ ] No new dependency, or a maintainer agreed to it; all licences are permissive.
- [ ] No telemetry and no unconfigured outbound connection added.
- [ ] This is not a security fix. (Those go to private reporting, see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).)
